Package com.irurueta.authserver.testsupport

Class TestCertificates

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.testsupport.TestCertificates
public final class TestCertificates extends Object
Generates self-signed client certificates at run time for the tests of the sign-in with a client certificate, so no certificate, key or key store is ever kept in the repository. It drives the keytool of the JDK that runs the tests: the JDK has no public API to issue a certificate, and a key store file only exists in a temporary directory for the time it takes to read the certificate back.
